Notices flag pages that need work, or warn readers. Put a notice at the very top of the page (or under a section heading, for one section). Every notice adds the page to a maintenance category, so moderators and editors can find what needs doing: see [[:Category:Wiki maintenance]]. Most notices take an optional reason as their first value, and all take date= (e.g. {{Cleanup|date=June 2026}}), small=yes (a smaller box, for sections) and nocat=yes (no category, for examples). == Notices == {| class="wikitable" style="width:100%" ! Gives: He ran the city's biggest garage.{{Clarify}} |} == Making a new notice == All notices use {{Notice}}: 
{{Notice
 | type     = content
 | title    = Short title (optional)
 | text     = What's wrong, and how to help.
 | category = Pages needing something
}}
type sets the colour and icon: delete (red), content (orange), style (yellow), notice (blue), move (purple) or archive (grey). icon changes the symbol. The box's look is in [[Template:Notice/styles.css]]. [[Category:Notice templates]]
